coverage.assertion: runtime-generated UUID4 identity and derived authorization scoped target pass the frozen validator
same ID implies same target and existing target cannot be overwritten
wrong authorization, attempt, namespace, freeze, Agent or authorization manifest binding is rejected
old r5c7e artifact remains unchanged and rejected by the frozen identity contract
offline fixture construction does not call transport connectivity

limits: The suite proves existing target collision and frozen contract checks. UUID4 uniqueness is probabilistic; failed invocations without an artifact have no persistent ID ledger.
